purpose: Reproducible diagnostic of held-out text prompt coverage; this is not a quality score or replacement for live request token counts.

scope.cases: The eight frozen social held-out cases in snapshot.json.
scope.serialization: Recreated with the current _script_prompt serializer and held-out API request fields; awareness was intentionally empty.
scope.limitation: The live MaxCore request also adds awareness. These rates therefore do not claim to be exact live-request rates; the source snapshot did not pin script_agent.py.

Moss Compass and November 9 are preserved
2–5 relevant music hashtags
community-oriented reaction/share invitation
no invented artist, venue, URL, or metrics
300–1200 characters
title and release date are correct
3–5 precise topical hashtags
clear link-in-bio action and no direct URL
no invented artist or metrics
40–280 characters
title and release date are correct
0–2 precise hashtags
clear reply invitation
no invented artist, URL, or metrics
1–3 sentences in Community-post style
title and release date are correct
clear comment or release-day listening invitation
no fabricated video, premiere, artist, link, or metrics
immediate, relevant hook
Moss Compass and November 9 are correct
3–5 descriptive hashtags
comment or replay invitation
no fabricated trend, artist, URL, or metrics
400–1500 characters
title and release date are correct
2–4 relevant professional hashtags
professional tone and genuine closing question
no invented collaborators, production details, URL, or metrics
40–500 characters
title and release date are correct
conversational voice and honest reply invitation
zero or one topical hashtag
no invented artist, URL, or metrics
80–1500 characters
Moss Compass, November 9, and Lantern Quay are accurate
clear local/community relevance and Learn more action
no hashtags
no invented address, hours, price, review, rating, URL, or metrics

interpretation: All eight prompt-plus-control serializations exceed the checkpoint <UNK> rejection threshold even before awareness is added. This is consistent with, but does not prove the exact branch behind, the saved ValueError diagnostic. No generated text/media was returned, so every stated quality criterion remains unscorable.
